messages.subject: Binding javascript output from multiple files to the same DOM element
parts:
I am able to embed a map I created in D3 in my shiny application and can get the zooming and panning and all that good stuff to work, but still can't figure out why I'm unable to use a tool tip script that is stored in a separate file to display a tooltip.  I'm using tooltip.js from http://bl.ocks.org/rveciana/5181105 to access the element properties and build a tool tip.  


I've copied the JS file that I embed in the Shiny application below.  This is part of a "landing" page of sorts, so there's no need for Shiny to do more than be a container for it.  If I try to insert :
 tags$script(src="tooltip.js")
into the head or the same div as the map it produces errors.  When I copy that source and include it as part of the code below the coordinates that the script returns are off by several hundred pixels on the x axis and ~ 50-100 on the y axis.  Does anyone else have any experience dealing with anything like this or could provide some suggestions for things to check out?  I had no issues with things when it was contained in an html file.

Thanks,
Billy

messages.subject: Re: Binding javascript output from multiple files to the same DOM element
parts: Finally figured things out.  The conflict occured in the style settings of bootstrap where it defaults to setting the opacity of class tooltip to 0.  Added .style('opacity', 1) to the JS and copied it into the javascript before each of the data loading functions and it worked exactly as I wanted.
